description: This file defines the ChartsApiController class which provides API endpoints related to project costs, investments, origin statistics, and matcher statistics within the Goteo crowdfunding platform. It includes methods for retrieving data formatted for visualization, access control for resources, and interaction with models like Project, Call, Matcher, and Origin.

classes.name: ChartsApiController
classes.description: Controller class providing API endpoints for retrieving project, call, matcher, and origin statistical data formatted for charts and visualizations within the Goteo platform.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the controller, setting database replication and cache options.

methods.name: getProject
methods.description: Retrieves a Project object by ID or object, enforcing visibility and access permissions.

methods.name: getCall
methods.description: Retrieves a Call object by ID, enforcing visibility and access permissions.

methods.name: getMatcher
methods.description: Retrieves a Matcher object by ID, enforcing ownership and admin permissions.

methods.name: projectCostsAction
methods.description: Returns project costs data formatted for D3 charts, including mandatory and optional costs with color coding.

methods.name: projectInvestsAction
methods.description: Returns project investment data over time, including cumulative amounts and targets for visualization.

methods.name: originStatsAction
methods.description: Provides origin statistics (e.g., referer, category) for projects, calls, or matchers with filtering options.

methods.name: statsMatcherAction
methods.description: Returns statistical data about a Matcher, including used and available amounts, raised funds, or project counts.

methods.name: originMatcherStatsAction
methods.description: Provides origin statistics for projects associated with matchers, grouped by specified criteria.
